articles.title: 2 killed as Fortuner rams into autorickshaw near Delhi's Kashmere Gate
articles.description: A speeding SUV collided with a three-wheeler in north Delhi, causing fatalities and serious injuries. The accident occurred on Yudhisthir Setu, leading to an initial FIR on rash driving. Two of the injured individuals later succumbed to their injuries, prompting further legal action. Authorities are currently working to identify and apprehend the driver responsible for the incident.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex rallies over 400 points, Nifty50 trades above 25,350
articles.full_text: Rupee ended higher against the US dollar, although it pared a large part of its gains during the session. The currency settled at 93.44, gaining 7 paise from its previous close. It had opened at 93.47 and moved between an intraday high of 93.25 and a low of 93.57 against the greenback. Forex traders said the rupee gave up some of its morning gains as weakness in domestic equities and a stronger dollar weighed on sentiment. Fresh geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran also contributed to risk aversion in global markets. However, lower crude oil prices provided support to the domestic currency and helped it retain some gains. Rupee had strengthened by 43 paise on Tuesday to close at 93.51 against the dollar, its highest level in seven months.

articles.title: CISCE launches SHINE 2026, a nationwide digital assessment initiative to identify learning gaps among students; 450 schools participate
articles.description: The CISCE has launched SHINE 2026, a nationwide digital diagnostic assessment for students of Classes 4, 6 and 9 across its affiliated schools. Nearly 450 schools participated within 48 hours, recording over three million student responses. The assessment will evaluate academic and socio-emotional competencies, with schools required to complete it by December 15, 2026.

articles.title: Google Gemini can now do more than answer questions: What Indian users can automate for free
articles.description: Google has expanded its Gemini AI assistant with a new Task mode that allows users to delegate everyday activities, including appointment bookings, shopping, grocery orders, bill analysis and calendar management. The feature is rolling out free of charge in six countries, including India. Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, it connects with more than 60 applications. While some capabilities remain US-exclusive initially, Google says users retain control through privacy safeguards, permission settings and confirmation requirements for critical actions.

articles.title: Microsoft launches new AI models for coding and cybersecurity to challenge OpenAI and Anthropic: What software engineers should know
articles.description: Microsoft has launched three specialised AI models for coding and cybersecurity, intensifying competition with OpenAI and Anthropic. The lineup includes MAI Code 2, MAI Code 2 Flash and MAI Cyber 2 Flash, designed for software development, vulnerability detection and threat investigation. Microsoft claims its models offer competitive performance at significantly lower costs. For Indian software engineers and IT companies, the launch highlights growing opportunities in AI-assisted coding, enterprise automation and cybersecurity, alongside evolving skill requirements.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' hits Rs 1,500 crore globally in record time
articles.description: Namit Malhotra's 'Ramayana', directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has crossed the Rs 1,000 crore mark domestically. The film achieved this milestone within just two weeks of its theatrical release. Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, it is now the sixth Indian film to reach this figure. In addition, 'Ramayana' has become the third Bollywood movie to join this exclusive club. Its worldwide gross collection currently stands at Rs 1,519.

articles.title: Who is Krishna Vamsi? About actor Ramya Krishnan’s husband
articles.description: Ramya Krishnan has put to rest the speculation regarding her relationship with director Krishna Vamsi. The couple, married since 2003 and parents to their son Ritvik, are now living separately to focus on their careers. This living arrangement has reportedly strengthened their bond and minimized disagreements, contrary to the rumors of a breakup. Recently, Ramya starred in 'Jailer 2' alongside the iconic Rajinikanth.

articles.title: Guitarist John Christ passes away at 61
articles.description: In a heartfelt announcement, the family of John Christ has revealed that the esteemed guitarist, recognized for co-founding the influential band Danzig, has died at 61. His passing, attributed to ongoing health challenges, has deeply affected the music community. Remembered for his artistry and commitment to teaching, Christ's influence in heavy metal will be honored for years to come.
